Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Jain
 Order
% 05.01.2026
1.
In the present case, the petitioner-Society is seeking quashing of order dated 26.08.2013.

2. The petitioner-Society had filed a complaint which resulted in registration of FIR No. 476/2006,
P.S. Sarita Vihar for offences punishable under Section 406, 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC.
3. After investigation, 'cancellation report' was filed before the learned Trial Court.
However, the petitioner-Society filed a protest petition and also filed a complaint under Section 200 Cr.P.C.
Such protest petition was also rejected by the learned Trial Court on 04.02.2013 and, consequently, the 'cancellation report' was accepted.

4. Such order was challenged by the petitioner-Society by filing the Revision before the Court of Sessions and the Sessions Court has upheld the acceptance of cancellation and has dismissed the abovesaid Revision Petition before the Court of Sessions and the Sessions Court has also dismissed the
